name: Small Language Model
description: Small Language Models (SLMs): hands-on CPU profiling, optimization, and evaluation practice for the Generative AI course.

children.name: Practice
children.description: Hands-on experiments with Small Language Models on local CPU hardware.

children.name: Profiling SLMs
children.description: Self-guided tutorial applying ONNX Runtime CPU profiling, Amdahl's Law, graph optimization, dynamic INT8 quantization, output validation, and post-book performance hypotheses to Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B-Instruct.

children.name: Overview
children.description: Tutorial purpose, CPU setup and memory budget, runnable notebook link, experimental provenance, minimal profiling example, and module roadmap.

children.name: Measurement and profiling
children.description: The Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B-Instruct case, prefill vs. decode and KV cache, paired timing, ONNX Runtime profiler JSON parsing, and call frequency vs. accumulated cost.

children.name: Graph optimization, INT8, and FP16
children.description: Amdahl's Law, ORT_ENABLE_ALL operator fusions, dynamic INT8 quantization on MatMul, variance and dtype caveats, and the FP16 CPU Cast counterexample.

children.name: Output validation and limits
children.description: Three-task functional and contract validation, observed 25 Nov 2026 results, AST plus subprocess containment vs. sandboxing, and benchmark limitations.

children.name: Beyond the book
children.description: Testable hypotheses for the 5,885 to 2,581 node drop (1.01x), Roofline and FlashAttention, speculative decoding, 2026 hardware studies, and Pareto frontiers.

children.name: Exercises
children.description: Eight worked interpretation, calculation, experimental-design, and four-criterion Pareto exercises with collapsible solutions.

children.name: Reference and glossary
children.description: Operational glossary, notebook section map, provenance boundaries, and primary references with publication dates.
